name: kailasa
description: KAILASA's internal marketplace of skills, plugins, agents, commands, hooks and MCP servers for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: codex-subagent
plugins.description: Delegate coding, analysis, and review tasks from Claude Code to OpenAI Codex agents via the codex CLI's headless exec mode, with explicit sandboxing, structured JSON output, and resumable multi-turn threads.

plugins.name: database-schema-visualizer
plugins.description: Build an interactive, explorable database schema map (pan/zoom canvas, per-table detail, search, cluster filtering) from Prisma/Diesel/SQL schemas or design docs, and publish it as an artifact.
